"LLM-Powered SQL Database Agents with LangGraph"
Get ready for an exciting live session where we explore the world of LLM-Powered SQL Database Agents using LangGraph! Watch as I demonstrate how to create powerful agents that can seamlessly query, analyze, and interact with SQL databases using natural language.
What You'll Learn:
Introduction to LangGraph and its application in building AI-driven database agents
Step-by-step walkthrough of setting up SQL database agents
Real-world use cases and practical examples
Advanced tips for natural language data interaction
Live coding demo & Q&A session
